action.command: for p in /dokumentation /doku /documentation; do code=$(curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' "http://127.0.0.1:32789$p"); echo "$code  $p"; done

tool_call.name: terminal
tool_call.arguments: {"summary": "Check documentation endpoint", "command": "for p in /dokumentation /doku /documentation; do code=$(curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' \"http://127.0.0.1:32789$p\"); echo \"$code  $p\"; done", "security_risk": "LOW"}
